Traffic Advisory 

On 19.01.2026, due to official exigencies, various traffic restrictions & diversions will be in place in both the carriageways and service roads around W Point, A Point ITO Chowk, BSZ Marg, DDU Marg, Mirdard Road, Mirdard Red Light, Ranjeet Singh Marg, Ranjeet Singh Flyover, Jangir Road, and Press Road.

Commuters are advised to avoid these routes between 08:00 AM to 06:00 PM and use alternative roads for a hassle-free journey. Parking will only be allowed in designated areas.

No vehicles will be allowed to be parked on Bahadurshah Zafar Marg, IP Marg, DDU Marg, Tagore Road, Vishnu Digambar Marg, Mirdard Road, Mirdard Red Light Ranjeet Singh Marg, Ranjeet Singh Flyover, Jangir Road, and Press Road (Both the carriageways), on that day.

Vehicles parked on these roads will be towed away and prosecuted as per law.

#DPTrafficAdvisory
